for stage in ['login','char']:

 class Socket(r.FakeSocket):
  def close(self): raise OSError('sanitized synthetic close failure')

  def __init__(self): self.live=True
  def is_alive(self): return self.live

  sock=Socket([raw]); sockets.append(sock); return sock
